name: Thoughtbound Phantasm
oracle_text:
Defender
Whenever you surveil, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
As long as this creature has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you surveil, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

needs.what: a trigger event fired once each time a player completes a surveil action (701.25), with a controller filter so "whenever you surveil" matches only surveils performed by this permanent's controller; it fires whatever the player does with the cards, including keeping all of them on top
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no surveil event; the closest are 'put_into_graveyard' and 'connives'/'investigates' (other keyword-action events), but a surveil that keeps every card on top puts nothing into the graveyard and must still trigger, so no existing event matches
